scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled inventory-stock report source through the real worker

criteria.description: The existing inventory-stock catalog contract is preserved with exactly ten current persisted-item fields, current value/status derivation, case-insensitive search, inclusive UTC createdAt filters, deterministic ordering, a 10,000-row bound and explicit exclusions.
criteria.limitations: The catalog is a current persisted inventory_items snapshot; it does not establish complete Vetus inventory parity, historical/as-of stock or accounting valuation semantics.

criteria.description: The stock source delegates to the explicit tenant-safe inventory_items projection, preserving the account predicate, parameterized escaped literal ILIKE, inclusive UTC date boundaries, deterministic name/id ordering and the 10,001-row query guard while deriving only current stockValue and reorderStatus.
criteria.limitations: The source proof is local/disposable; target grants, target RLS/runtime roles, production scale and operational database acceptance remain outside this bounded gate.

criteria.description: The worker composes the asynchronous inventory-stock source, validates filters, source responses, numeric facts and derived fields, maps exactly ten fields and retains existing scheduled job, audit, recipient and one-shot semantics.
criteria.limitations: Continuous/distributed worker operations and delivery providers are not certified by this bounded gate.

criteria.description: Fresh disposable PostgreSQL process evidence proves concurrent two-account run-once isolation, current value/status derivation, inclusive filters, exact ten-field rows, durable execution identity and non-PII audit/log behavior; unit/source guards prove fail-closed overflow and malformed cases.
criteria.limitations: The process uses disposable local PostgreSQL and mock delivery; it does not certify target roles, provider delivery, distributed execution, external systems or production behavior.

criteria.description: Intentional RED/GREEN, focused coverage, full module and worker regressions, typecheck/build, secrets, formatting and diff hygiene satisfy the bounded repository quality bar.
criteria.limitations: The validators are local; remote CI, target operations, external homologation and release acceptance remain open.

criteria.description: A fresh read-only independent review returned bounded approval without a CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW finding.
criteria.limitations: Approval is limited to this bounded local slice and is not a global ERP, target or production approval.

criteria.description: The bounded result is reconciled without promoting CVG-004, general Vetus parity, clinical parity, enterprise readiness, target operations or release acceptance.
criteria.limitations: General Vetus parity remains 4/11 verified, clinical parity 2/3 verified and enterprise readiness 95/100 with 42 PASS, 3 WARN and 1 FAIL.

gaps: The report is a current persisted inventory_items snapshot only; historical/as-of stock, lots, movements, invoices and accounting valuation remain outside scope.

Disposable local services do not certify target RLS/runtime roles, backup/restore, RTO/RPO, distributed worker operations, remote CI, accessibility, operational LGPD, providers, production or release acceptance.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation request and original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled inventory-stock report source through the real worker
authority.decision: Authorize only reversible inventory-module and worker implementation plus focused and disposable PostgreSQL/process verification of the existing read-only inventory-stock schedule. The source may read the persisted inventory_items projection through the existing explicit tenant-safe source, expose only the ten existing catalog fields after deriving current stockValue and reorderStatus from the persisted quantity, reorder level and unit cost, apply case-insensitive SKU/name search and strict inclusive UTC createdAt date filters, deterministic name/id ordering and a 10,000-row bound, and fail closed on missing/foreign/malformed or unsafe derived output. Preserve existing durable schedule execution/export audit and one-shot semantics. Exclude lots, movements, invoices, historical/as-of valuation, CRUD, migrations, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation, backfill and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing inventory_items schema/RLS or numeric/timestamp semantics, adding joins/fields/filters, changing worker schedule/audit behavior, adding historical/lot/movement/invoice/valuation behavior, provider delivery, target operations or production behavior.

next_action: Keep CVG-004/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL with promotion BLOCKED; choose any next gap only through fresh scouting and a new implementation-ready authority.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to inventory_items schema, account RLS/FORCE-RLS or persisted quantity/cost/timestamp semantics
Changes to worker bootstrap, schedule claiming, report execution/export/audit or one-shot failure behavior
